idea-plugin.name: Code Assist
idea-plugin.description:
Simple plugin that requests an HTTP API and displays the result in the task bar.

Configure your API token and refresh interval in Settings... | Tools | Code Assist.

Go check my repo : https://github.com/Iron-Wolf
